snippet.title: Fret Nice (2010) - Full Gameplay | XBOX 360 ARCADE  |   UHD | 4K |
snippet.description:
Fret Nice is a platform game developed by Pieces Interactive AB and published by Tecmo. The game was released on Xbox Live Arcade on February 4, 2010, and PlayStation Network on February 24, 2010.[1] The game was designed to use a guitar controller, but can also be played using a normal gamepad. Players control the "Vibrant Chords", a rock band duo, as they traverse side-scrolling stages while avoiding enemies and hazards. 
Pieces Interactive AB ©
